aspx
<%@ Page Language="VB" AutoEventWireup="true" %>
<%@ Import Namespace="System.Data" %>
<%@ Import Namespace="System.Data.SqlClient" %>
<%@ Import Namespace="System.Web.Services" %>
<%@ Import Namespace="System.Web.Script.Serialization" %>
<%@ Import Namespace="System.Collections.Generic" %>

<script runat="server">
    ' ==========================================================
    ' 🌟 1. 全域資料庫連線字串 (對齊戰情室規格)
    ' ==========================================================
    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnStr As String = "Server=localhost;Database=stockchangedate;Trusted_Connection=True;"

    ' 輔助函數：將 DataTable 轉為 JSON 格式字串
    Private Shared Function DataTableToJson(dt As DataTable) As String
        Dim dictList As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
        For Each row As DataRow In dt.Rows
            Dim dict As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
            For Each col As DataColumn In dt.Columns
                dict(col.ColumnName) = If(IsDBNull(row(col)), Nothing, row(col))
            Next
            dictList.Add(dict)
        Next
        Dim js As New JavaScriptSerializer()
        js.MaxJsonLength = Int32.MaxValue
        Return js.Serialize(dictList)
    End Function

    ' ==========================================================
    ' 🌟 2. 獲取所有量化範本清單
    ' ==========================================================
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetTemplates() As String
        Dim dt As New DataTable()
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnStr)
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TemplateID, Category, Title, StrategyDesc, CorrectSQL, Unlocks, SortOrder FROM [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates] WHERE IsActive=1 ORDER BY SortOrder ASC, TemplateID ASC"
                Using cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                    Using sda As New SqlDataAdapter(cmd)
                        sda.Fill(dt)
                    End Using
                End Using
            End Using
            Return "{ ""status"": ""success"", ""data"": " & DataTableToJson(dt) & " }"
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return "{ ""status"": ""error"", ""message"": """ & ex.Message.Replace("""", "\""") & """ }"
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ==========================================================
    ' 🌟 3. 儲存或新增範本入庫
    ' ==========================================================
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function SaveTemplate(id As String, category As String, title As String, desc As String, sqlCode As String, sortOrder As Integer) As String
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnStr)
                conn.Open()
                If String.IsNullOrEmpty(id) OrElse id = "0" Then
                    ' 新增
                    Dim sql As String = "INSERT INTO [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates] (Category, Title, StrategyDesc, CorrectSQL, SortOrder, IsActive, CreatedAt) VALUES (@cat, @title, @desc, @sql, @sort, 1, GETDATE())"
                    Using cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@cat", category)
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@title", title)
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@desc", desc)
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@sql", sqlCode)
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@sort", sortOrder)
                        cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
                    End Using
                Else
                    ' 更新
                    Dim sql As String = "UPDATE [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates] SET Category=@cat, Title=@title, StrategyDesc=@desc, CorrectSQL=@sql, SortOrder=@sort, UpdatedAt=GETDATE() WHERE TemplateID=@id"
                    Using cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@cat", category)
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@title", title)
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@desc", desc)
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@sql", sqlCode)
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@sort", sortOrder)
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", id)
                        cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
                    End Using
                End If
            End Using
            Return "{ ""status"": ""success"" }"
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return "{ ""status"": ""error"", ""message"": """ & ex.Message.Replace("""", "\""") & """ }"
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ==========================================================
    ' 🌟 4. 動態擊發 SQL 測試 (殺手級功能！)
    ' ==========================================================
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function ExecuteSQL(id As Integer) As String
        Dim dt As New DataTable()
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnStr)
                ' 直接呼叫長官已經建好的 sp_RunQuantTemplate 預存程序
                Using cmd As New SqlCommand("sp_RunQuantTemplate", conn)
                    cmd.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ID", id)
                    cmd.CommandTimeout = 30 ' 給予 30 秒充裕計算時間
                    Using sda As New SqlDataAdapter(cmd)
                        sda.Fill(dt)
                    End Using
                End Using
            End Using
            Return "{ ""status"": ""success"", ""data"": " & DataTableToJson(dt) & " }"
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return "{ ""status"": ""error"", ""message"": """ & ex.Message.Replace("""", "\""").Replace(vbCrLf, " ") & """ }"
        End Try
    End Function
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-TW">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>Zen AI 量化範本開發旗艦艙</title>
    <style>
        * { box-sizing: border-box; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; }
        body { background-color: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc; margin: 0; padding: 15px; display: flex; height: 100vh; gap: 15px; overflow: hidden; }
        
        /* 📜 左側清單面板 */
        .sidebar { width: 350px; background: #1e293b; border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
        .sidebar-header { padding: 15px; background: #0f172a; border-bottom: 1px solid #334155; }
        .sidebar-header h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.15rem; color: #f59e0b; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
        .search-box { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; margin-top: 10px; background: #090d16; border: 1px solid #38bdf8; color: #fff; border-radius: 4px; }
        .search-box:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(56,189,248,0.5); }
        .template-list { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
        .template-item { padding: 12px 15px; border-bottom: 1px solid #334155; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; }
        .template-item:hover, .template-item.active { background: #0284c7; border-left: 4px solid #facc15; }
        .t-cat { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #fcd34d; margin-bottom: 4px; display: block; }
        .t-title { font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: bold; line-height: 1.4; }

        /* 💻 右側主區域 (編輯區 + 結果區) */
        .main-panel { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 15px; overflow: hidden; }
        
        /* 上半部：編輯器 */
        .editor-panel { background: #1e293b; border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 8px; padding: 15px 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 0.55; overflow-y: auto; }
        .editor-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 15px; border-bottom: 1px solid #334155; padding-bottom: 10px; }
        .editor-header h2 { margin: 0; color: #38bdf8; font-size: 1.2rem; }
        .btn-group button { padding: 6px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; margin-left: 8px; transition: 0.2s; }
        .btn-new { background: #3b82f6; color: white; }
        .btn-save { background: #10b981; color: white; }
        .btn-run { background: #f59e0b; color: #000; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(245,158,11,0.4); }
        .btn-group button:hover { opacity: 0.8; transform: translateY(-1px); }

        .form-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
        .form-group { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
        .form-group label { font-size: 0.8rem; color: #94a3b8; margin-bottom: 4px; font-weight: bold; }
        .form-control { background: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #475569; color: #fff; padding: 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.9rem; }
        .form-control:focus { outline: none; border-color: #38bdf8; }
        
        .sql-editor { flex: 1; min-height: 200px; font-family: Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.4; color: #38bdf8; background: #090d16; border: 1px solid #38bdf8; padding: 12px; resize: vertical; }

        /* 下半部：執行結果區 */
        .result-panel { background: #1e293b; border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 8px; flex: 0.45; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
        .result-header { padding: 10px 15px; background: #0f172a; border-bottom: 1px solid #334155; font-weight: bold; color: #22c55e; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
        .result-body { flex: 1; overflow: auto; padding: 0; background: #0b1120; }
        
        /* 戰情報表表格樣式 */
        table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: #e2e8f0; font-size: 0.85rem; white-space: nowrap; }
        thead { background: #334155; position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10; }
        th, td { border: 1px solid #475569; padding: 6px 10px; text-align: left; }
        th { color: #f8fafc; font-weight: bold; }
        tbody tr:hover { background: #1e293b; }
        
        .loading { color: #facc15; padding: 20px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: bold; }
        .error-msg { color: #ef4444; padding: 20px; font-family: Consolas; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <!-- 左側導覽列 -->
    <div class="sidebar">
        <div class="sidebar-header">
            <h2>🗄️ 量化範本庫</h2>
            <input type="text" id="searchInput" class="search-box" placeholder="🔍 搜尋關鍵字..." oninput="filterList()">
        </div>
        <ul class="template-list" id="templateList">
            <li class="loading">📡 資料庫連線中...</li>
        </ul>
    </div>

    <!-- 右側主區域 -->
    <div class="main-panel">
        <!-- 編輯器 -->
        <div class="editor-panel">
            <div class="editor-header">
                <h2 id="editorTitle">📝 準備就緒</h2>
                <div class="btn-group">
                    <button class="btn-new" onclick="createNew()">➕ 新增</button>
                    <button class="btn-save" onclick="saveTemplate()">💾 儲存入庫</button>
                    <button class="btn-run" onclick="executeCurrentSQL()" id="btnRun">🚀 測試執行此範本</button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="form-row">
                <div class="form-group" style="flex: 0.2;">
                    <label>ID</label>
                    <input type="text" id="t_id" class="form-control" readonly style="background: #334155; color: #94a3b8;">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group" style="flex: 0.3;">
                    <label>分類 (Category)</label>
                    <input type="text" id="t_cat" class="form-control">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group" style="flex: 0.5;">
                    <label>權重 (SortOrder)</label>
                    <input type="number" id="t_sort" class="form-control" value="100">
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="form-group" style="margin-bottom: 10px;">
                <label>標題 (Title)</label>
                <input type="text" id="t_title" class="form-control">
            </div>
            <div class="form-group" style="margin-bottom: 10px;">
                <label>戰略意義 (StrategyDesc)</label>
                <input type="text" id="t_desc" class="form-control">
            </div>
            <div class="form-group" style="flex: 1;">
                <label>💻 T-SQL 查詢語句 (CorrectSQL)</label>
                <textarea id="t_sql" class="form-control sql-editor" spellcheck="false"></textarea>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 執行結果表格 -->
        <div class="result-panel">
            <div class="result-header" id="resHeader">📊 動態實戰結果區 (請點擊上方火箭發射)</div>
            <div class="result-body" id="resBody">
                <div style="color:#64748b; padding:20px; text-align:center;">等待接收指令...</div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        let allData = [];

        // 1. 呼叫 ASP.NET 後端 WebMethod
        async function callApi(methodName, payload = {}) {
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`quant_editor.aspx/${methodName}`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
                });
                const result = await response.json();
                return JSON.parse(result.d); // ASP.NET 回傳值包在 d 裡面
            } catch (err) {
                console.error("API 錯誤:", err);
                return { status: "error", message: "網路通訊異常" };
            }
        }

        // 2. 載入清單
        async function loadTemplates() {
            const res = await callApi("GetTemplates");
            if (res.status === 'success') {
                allData = res.data;
                renderList(allData);
                if(allData.length > 0) selectTemplate(allData[0].TemplateID);
            } else {
                document.getElementById('templateList').innerHTML = `<li class="error-msg">讀取失敗：${res.message}</li>`;
            }
        }

        function renderList(list) {
            const ul = document.getElementById('templateList');
            ul.innerHTML = list.map(t => `
                <li class="template-item" id="li_${t.TemplateID}" onclick="selectTemplate(${t.TemplateID})">
                    <span class="t-cat">[${t.TemplateID}] ${t.Category} (權重:${t.SortOrder})</span>
                    <span class="t-title">${t.Title}</span>
                </li>
            `).join('');
        }

        function filterList() {
            const kw = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
            renderList(allData.filter(t => t.Title.toLowerCase().includes(kw) || t.Category.toLowerCase().includes(kw)));
        }

        function selectTemplate(id) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.template-item').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
            const li = document.getElementById('li_' + id);
            if (li) li.classList.add('active');

            const t = allData.find(x => x.TemplateID === id);
            if (t) {
                document.getElementById('editorTitle').innerText = `📝 編輯 [${id}] 號範本`;
                document.getElementById('t_id').value = t.TemplateID;
                document.getElementById('t_cat').value = t.Category;
                document.getElementById('t_sort').value = t.SortOrder;
                document.getElementById('t_title').value = t.Title;
                document.getElementById('t_desc').value = t.StrategyDesc || "";
                document.getElementById('t_sql').value = t.CorrectSQL;
                
                // 清空結果區
                document.getElementById('resHeader').innerText = `📊 動態實戰結果區 - 待命`;
                document.getElementById('resBody').innerHTML = `<div style="color:#64748b; padding:20px; text-align:center;">已載入範本，點擊 [🚀 測試執行] 檢視成果...</div>`;
            }
        }

        function createNew() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.template-item').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
            document.getElementById('editorTitle').innerText = `✨ 新增量化範本`;
            document.getElementById('t_id').value = "0";
            document.getElementById('t_cat').value = "新戰術分類";
            document.getElementById('t_sort').value = "100";
            document.getElementById('t_title').value = "";
            document.getElementById('t_desc').value = "";
            document.getElementById('t_sql').value = "/*資料庫:stockchangedate*/ TOP 100 T.*\nFROM (\n    SELECT \n\n) T\nORDER BY ...";
        }

        // 3. 儲存入庫
        async function saveTemplate() {
            const payload = {
                id: document.getElementById('t_id').value,
                category: document.getElementById('t_cat').value,
                title: document.getElementById('t_title').value,
                desc: document.getElementById('t_desc').value,
                sqlCode: document.getElementById('t_sql').value,
                sortOrder: parseInt(document.getElementById('t_sort').value) || 100
            };

            if (!payload.title || !payload.sqlCode) { alert("⚠️ 標題與 SQL 為必填！"); return; }

            const res = await callApi("SaveTemplate", payload);
            if (res.status === 'success') {
                alert("✅ 儲存成功！");
                loadTemplates();
            } else { alert("❌ 儲存失敗：" + res.message); }
        }

        // 4. 🚀 殺手級：直接執行預存程序並繪製動態表格！
        async function executeCurrentSQL() {
            const tid = document.getElementById('t_id').value;
            if (!tid || tid === "0") { alert("⚠️ 請先儲存範本後再執行測試！"); return; }

            const resBody = document.getElementById('resBody');
            const resHeader = document.getElementById('resHeader');
            
            resHeader.innerText = `⏳ 正在運算 [ID: ${tid}]，請稍候...`;
            resBody.innerHTML = `<div class="loading">⚡ SQL 引擎全速運算中...</div>`;

            const res = await callApi("ExecuteSQL", { id: parseInt(tid) });

            if (res.status === 'success') {
                const rows = res.data;
                resHeader.innerText = `✅ 運算完成！共擷取 ${rows.length} 筆黑馬標的`;
                
                if (rows.length === 0) {
                    resBody.innerHTML = `<div style="color:#94a3b8; padding:20px; text-align:center;">此條件下無符合結果</div>`;
                    return;
                }

                // 動態產生表格 Header
                const columns = Object.keys(rows[0]);
                let tableHtml = `<table><thead><tr>`;
                columns.forEach(col => { tableHtml += `<th>${col}</th>`; });
                tableHtml += `</tr></thead><tbody>`;

                // 動態產生表格內容
                rows.forEach(row => {
                    tableHtml += `<tr>`;
                    columns.forEach(col => {
                        let val = row[col];
                        if (val === null) val = "";
                        tableHtml += `<td>${val}</td>`;
                    });
                    tableHtml += `</tr>`;
                });
                tableHtml += `</tbody></table>`;
                resBody.innerHTML = tableHtml;
            } else {
                resHeader.innerText = `❌ 執行異常`;
                resBody.innerHTML = `<div class="error-msg">語法錯誤或崩潰：<br>${res.message}</div>`;
            }
        }

        window.onload = loadTemplates;
    </script>
</body>
</html>

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
================================================================================
🌟 Zen AI 量化範本庫全量精準入庫中樞 (V3.1 支援預存程序版)
檔案位置：C:\test_c\import_myword2_to_sql.py
功能：新增支援 EXEC / EXECUTE 預存程序指令的自動匯入！
================================================================================
"""

import os
import sys
import re
import pyodbc

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

SOURCE_HTML = r"C:\inetpub\wwwroot\androidapp\memory\myword_2.html"
SERVER = "localhost"
DATABASE = "stockchangedate"
CONN_STR = f"DRIVER={{SQL Server}};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes;"

def ensure_table_exists(conn):
    create_sql = """
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates]', N'U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates] (
            [TemplateID]     INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
            [Category]       NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
            [Title]          NVARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
            [StrategyDesc]   NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
            [CorrectSQL]     NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL,
            [Unlocks]        NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
            [TargetDB]       NVARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'stockchangedate',
            [SortOrder]      INT DEFAULT 100,
            [IsActive]       BIT DEFAULT 1,
            [UsageCount]     INT DEFAULT 0,
            [LastUsedDate]   DATETIME NULL,
            [CreatedAt]      DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE(),
            [UpdatedAt]      DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE()
        );
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_QuantSqlTemplates_Cat_Sort] 
        ON [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates] ([Category], [SortOrder], [IsActive]);
    END
    """
    with conn.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute(create_sql)
        conn.commit()

def parse_all_database_blocks(text):
    if "<pre" in text:
        start_pos = text.find(">", text.find("<pre")) + 1
        end_pos = text.rfind("</pre>")
        if start_pos > 0 and end_pos > start_pos:
            text = text[start_pos:end_pos]

    text = text.replace("&lt;", "<").replace("&gt;", ">").replace("&amp;", "&").replace("&quot;", '"')

    split_pattern = re.compile(r'(?=\/\*\s*(?:資料庫\s*:\s*)?(?:stockchangedate|stockchange)\s*\*\/)', re.IGNORECASE)
    raw_blocks = split_pattern.split(text)

    templates = []
    
    for idx, block in enumerate(raw_blocks):
        block = block.strip()
        if len(block) < 15:
            continue

        # 🌟 核心修復：加入 EXEC 與 EXECUTE 的合法性識別！
        if not re.search(r'\b(TOP|SELECT|FROM|EXEC|EXECUTE)\b', block, re.IGNORECASE):
            continue

        db_match = re.search(r'\/\*\s*(?:資料庫\s*:\s*)?([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\s*\*\/', block)
        target_db = db_match.group(1).strip() if db_match else "stockchangedate"

        cat_match = re.search(r'建議分類(?:\(cat\))?[:：]\s*(.*?)$', block, re.MULTILINE)
        if cat_match:
            category = cat_match.group(1).strip()
        else:
            group_m = re.search(r'【(.*?)】', block)
            category = group_m.group(1).strip() if group_m else "量化綜合"
        category = re.sub(r'[\r\n/*]', '', category).strip()[:180] or "量化綜合"

        title_match = re.search(r'建議標題(?:\(title\))?[:：]\s*(.*?)$', block, re.MULTILINE)
        if title_match:
            title = title_match.group(1).strip()
        else:
            title_candidate = ""
            for line in block.splitlines():
                line_str = line.strip()
                if line_str.startswith('--') or line_str.startswith('/*'):
                    cleaned_line = re.sub(r'^[\s\/*\-]+|[\s\/*\-]+$', '', line_str).strip()
                    if len(cleaned_line) > 3 and not cleaned_line.startswith('資料庫'):
                        title_candidate = cleaned_line
                        break
            title = title_candidate if title_candidate else f"量化戰術範本_{idx}"
        title = re.sub(r'[\r\n/*]', '', title).strip()[:450]

        desc_match = re.search(r'戰略意義[:：]\s*([\s\S]*?)(?:\*\/|$)', block)
        if desc_match:
            desc = desc_match.group(1).strip()
        else:
            desc_lines = [l.strip() for l in block.splitlines() if l.strip().startswith('--') or '【' in l]
            desc = "\n".join(desc_lines[:6]) if desc_lines else "自 myword_2 全量歷史範本庫提取"

        unlocks_match = re.search(r'解鎖.*?[:：]\s*(.*?)$', block, re.MULTILINE)
        unlocks = unlocks_match.group(1).strip() if unlocks_match else ""

        sql_clean = re.sub(r'\/\*\s*建議分類[\s\S]*?\*\/', '', block).strip()
        sql_clean = re.sub(r'^[=\-─━*]{5,}', '', sql_clean).strip()
        sql_clean = re.sub(r'[=\-─━*]{5,}$', '', sql_clean).strip()

        templates.append({
            "category": category,
            "title": title,
            "desc": desc,
            "unlocks": unlocks,
            "target_db": target_db,
            "sql": sql_clean
        })

    return templates

def main():
    if not os.path.exists(SOURCE_HTML):
        print(f"❌ 找不到來源檔案：{SOURCE_HTML}")
        return

    print(f"📖 正在讀取來源檔案：{SOURCE_HTML} ...")
    with open(SOURCE_HTML, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
        html_text = f.read()

    print(f"⚡ 啟動全量邊界切片 (支援 EXEC 預存程序)...")
    templates = parse_all_database_blocks(html_text)
    print(f"🎯 成功全面切片挖掘出 {len(templates)} 組獨立量化範本！")

    if not templates: return

    print("🔌 正在連線 SQL Server 資料庫 [stockchangedate] 執行入庫...")
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=15) as conn:
            ensure_table_exists(conn)
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            imported_count = 0
            updated_count = 0

            for idx, t in enumerate(templates, 1):
                cursor.execute("SELECT TemplateID FROM [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates] WHERE [Title] = ?", (t["title"],))
                row = cursor.fetchone()

                if row:
                    update_sql = "UPDATE [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates] SET [Category]=?, [StrategyDesc]=?, [CorrectSQL]=?, [Unlocks]=?, [TargetDB]=?, [UpdatedAt]=GETDATE() WHERE [TemplateID]=?"
                    cursor.execute(update_sql, (t["category"], t["desc"], t["sql"], t["unlocks"], t["target_db"], row[0]))
                    updated_count += 1
                else:
                    insert_sql = "INSERT INTO [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates] ([Category], [Title], [StrategyDesc], [CorrectSQL], [Unlocks], [TargetDB], [SortOrder]) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)"
                    cursor.execute(insert_sql, (t["category"], t["title"], t["desc"], t["sql"], t["unlocks"], t["target_db"], idx * 10))
                    imported_count += 1

            conn.commit()

        print("=" * 70)
        print(f"🎉 範本全量入庫作業圓滿大成功！")
        print(f"📊 統計結果：新增入庫 {imported_count} 筆 ｜ 同步更新 {updated_count} 筆")
        print("=" * 70)

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 資料庫寫入失敗: {e}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
================================================================================
🌟 Zen AI 預存程序專屬安全補入中樞 (V1.0)
檔案位置：C:\test_c\import_sp_only.py
安全守則：
1. 僅提取帶有 EXEC / EXECUTE / sp_ 的預存程序範本
2. 絕對不更新 (UPDATE) 任何現有資料，保護資料庫已校正好的成果
3. 僅對不存在的項目進行補缺寫入 (INSERT ONLY)
================================================================================
"""

import os
import sys
import re
import pyodbc

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

SOURCE_HTML = r"C:\inetpub\wwwroot\androidapp\memory\myword_2.html"
SERVER = "localhost"
DATABASE = "stockchangedate"
CONN_STR = f"DRIVER={{SQL Server}};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes;"

def parse_sp_blocks_only(text):
    if "<pre" in text:
        start_pos = text.find(">", text.find("<pre")) + 1
        end_pos = text.rfind("</pre>")
        if start_pos > 0 and end_pos > start_pos:
            text = text[start_pos:end_pos]

    text = text.replace("&lt;", "<").replace("&gt;", ">").replace("&amp;", "&").replace("&quot;", '"')

    # 以 /*資料庫 或 /*stock 或 換行 EXEC 為邊界
    split_pattern = re.compile(r'(?=\/\*\s*(?:資料庫\s*:\s*)?(?:stockchangedate|stockchange)\s*\*\/|\bEXEC\s+|\bEXECUTE\s+)', re.IGNORECASE)
    raw_blocks = split_pattern.split(text)

    sp_templates = []
    
    for idx, block in enumerate(raw_blocks):
        block = block.strip()
        if len(block) < 10:
            continue

        # 🌟 核心過濾：必須包含 EXEC / EXECUTE 或 sp_ 才是我們要的預存程序！
        if not re.search(r'\b(EXEC|EXECUTE)\b|\bsp_[a-zA-Z0-9_]+', block, re.IGNORECASE):
            continue

        # 提取目標資料庫
        db_match = re.search(r'\/\*\s*(?:資料庫\s*:\s*)?([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\s*\*\/', block)
        target_db = db_match.group(1).strip() if db_match else "stockchangedate"

        # 提取分類 (若無則預設為 [預存程序])
        cat_match = re.search(r'建議分類(?:\(cat\))?[:：]\s*(.*?)$', block, re.MULTILINE)
        category = cat_match.group(1).strip() if cat_match else "系統預存程序"
        category = re.sub(r'[\r\n/*]', '', category).strip()[:180] or "系統預存程序"

        # 提取標題
        title_match = re.search(r'建議標題(?:\(title\))?[:：]\s*(.*?)$', block, re.MULTILINE)
        if title_match:
            title = title_match.group(1).strip()
        else:
            # 抓取包含 sp_ 或 EXEC 的那一行作為標題
            title_candidate = ""
            for line in block.splitlines():
                l = line.strip()
                if "sp_" in l or "EXEC" in l.upper():
                    title_candidate = re.sub(r'[\s\/*\-]+', ' ', l).strip()
                    break
            title = title_candidate if title_candidate else f"預存程序範本_{idx}"
        title = re.sub(r'[\r\n/*]', '', title).strip()[:450]

        # 提取說明
        desc_match = re.search(r'戰略意義[:：]\s*([\s\S]*?)(?:\*\/|$)', block)
        desc = desc_match.group(1).strip() if desc_match else "預存程序專用執行範本"

        # 提取乾淨的 EXEC SQL
        sql_clean = re.sub(r'\/\*\s*建議分類[\s\S]*?\*\/', '', block).strip()
        sql_clean = re.sub(r'^[=\-─━*]{5,}', '', sql_clean).strip()
        sql_clean = re.sub(r'[=\-─━*]{5,}$', '', sql_clean).strip()

        sp_templates.append({
            "category": category,
            "title": title,
            "desc": desc,
            "target_db": target_db,
            "sql": sql_clean
        })

    return sp_templates

def main():

javascript

    title: "輸入股票代號+回測天數 選第二個執行預存程序有勝率統計(不同天數>30 回報率有相當差別)",

python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
================================================================================
🌟 Zen AI JS 物件格式預存程序安全提取中樞 (V1.0)
檔案位置：C:\test_c\import_js_sp.py
功能：專門解析 { cat: "...", title: "...", sql: `...` } 格式，只匯入預存程序，絕不覆蓋現有資料
================================================================================
"""

import os
import sys
import re
import pyodbc

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, 'reconfigure'):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

SOURCE_HTML = r"C:\inetpub\wwwroot\androidapp\memory\myword_2.html"
SERVER = "localhost"
DATABASE = "stockchangedate"
CONN_STR = f"DRIVER={{SQL Server}};SERVER={SERVER};DATABASE={DATABASE};Trusted_Connection=yes;"

def extract_js_sp_templates(text):
    # 1. 提取 <pre> 內的純文字 (若有的話)
    if "<pre" in text:
        start_pos = text.find(">", text.find("<pre")) + 1
        end_pos = text.rfind("</pre>")
        if start_pos > 0 and end_pos > start_pos:
            text = text[start_pos:end_pos]

    text = text.replace("&lt;", "<").replace("&gt;", ">").replace("&amp;", "&").replace("&quot;", '"')

    # 🌟 核心正則：鎖定 { ... sql: `...` } 的完整 JS 物件
    # 支援 multiline，不會受屬性順序影響
    obj_pattern = re.compile(r'\{[^{}]*?sql\s*:\s*`([\s\S]*?)`\s*\}', re.MULTILINE)
    
    extracted = []
    for m in obj_pattern.finditer(text):
        full_obj_text = m.group(0)
        sql_body = m.group(1).strip()

        # 🌟 安全過濾：只鎖定包含 EXEC 或 sp_ 的預存程序！
        if not ("EXEC" in sql_body.upper() or "SP_" in sql_body.lower()):
            continue

        # 提取分類 (cat 或 category)
        cat_match = re.search(r'(?:cat|category)\s*:\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']', full_obj_text)
        cat = cat_match.group(1).strip() if cat_match else "預存程序"

        # 提取標題 (title 或 name)
        title_match = re.search(r'(?:title|name)\s*:\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']', full_obj_text)
        title = title_match.group(1).strip() if title_match else "未命名預存程序"

        # 清洗 SQL 本體 (去除尾端可能殘留的 ` 或空白)
        sql_clean = sql_body.strip()
        sql_clean = re.sub(r'`$', '', sql_clean).strip()

        extracted.append({
            "category": cat,
            "title": title,
            "sql": sql_clean
        })

    return extracted

def main():
    if not os.path.exists(SOURCE_HTML):
        print(f"❌ 找不到來源檔案：{SOURCE_HTML}")
        return

    print(f"📖 正在讀取：{SOURCE_HTML} ...")
    with open(SOURCE_HTML, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
        content = f.read()

    print(f"🔍 正在精準抓取所有的 {{ cat: ..., title: ..., sql: `...` }} 預存程序物件...")
    templates = extract_js_sp_templates(content)
    print(f"🎯 成功鎖定 {len(templates)} 組 JS 格式預存程序！")

    if not templates:
        print("ℹ️ 未找到符合條件的 JS 物件格式預存程序。")
        return

    print("🔌 連線資料庫，執行【只新增、零覆蓋】安全作業...")
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            inserted = 0
            skipped = 0

            for t in templates:
                # 🌟 核心防禦：檢查資料庫是否已存在同標題範本
                cursor.execute("SELECT TemplateID FROM [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates] WHERE [Title] = ?", (t["title"],))
                row = cursor.fetchone()

                if row:
                    # 已經有了就絕對不 UPDATE！
                    skipped += 1
                else:
                    # 只有缺少的才補入
                    insert_sql = """
                    INSERT INTO [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates] 
                    ([Category], [Title], [StrategyDesc], [CorrectSQL], [TargetDB], [SortOrder], [IsActive]) 
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'stockchangedate', 950, 1)
                    """
                    desc = f"自 JS 物件格式安全補入，分類: {t['category']}"
                    cursor.execute(insert_sql, (t["category"], t["title"], desc, t["sql"]))
                    inserted += 1
                    print(f"  ➕ 成功補入: [{t['category']}] {t['title'][:35]}...")

            conn.commit()

        print("=" * 65)
        print(f"🎉 預存程序安全補入完成！")
        print(f"🟢 補入全新項目: {inserted} 筆")
        print(f"🛡️ 略過已存在項目 (保護現有資料 100% 不動): {skipped} 筆")
        print("=" * 65)

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 資料庫作業異常: {e}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

3. 💰 即時行情來源鐵律：
   - [MasterStockAnalysis] 只有 `盤中現價`、`盤中總量`、`專家實戰總分`、`產業分類`，【絕對沒有 成交價 與 漲幅】！
   - 需要標準行情時，必須串聯：`LEFT JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON LTRIM(RTRIM(B.代號)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(主表.代號))`
     抓取 `B.成交價 AS 現價, B.漲幅 AS [今日漲幅%], B.總量 AS [成交量(張)], B.股本億 AS [股本(億)]`。
4. 🛡️ 笛卡兒積防爆與多對一鎖定：
   - `value` 每日評價表必帶 `AND V.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM value)` (防 2500 倍膨脹)。
   - `financesum` 財報季表必用 `ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn ... rn=1` (取每檔最新一季)。
   - `allcross_live` 金叉數據必用 `ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn ... rn=1` (徹底消滅全 0 與 NULL)。
   - 一字漲跌停防衛：除法必用 `NULLIF(最高 - 最低, 0)`，收盤位置% 加 `ISNULL(..., 100.0)`。
   - 勝率百分比防呆：`CASE WHEN WinRate <= 1.0 THEN WinRate * 100.0 ELSE WinRate END` (防 5240% 膨脹)。

/*資料庫:stockchangedate*/ TOP 100 T.*
FROM (
    SELECT ...
) T
ORDER BY T.[主要排序欄位] DESC
